text:
Maya: Quick ask — we need a compact enterprise one-pager that stitches security + SLA + deploy-mode messaging for next week's partner webinar. short, skimmable, and sales-ready. :rocket:

Jordan: +1. Target audience: platform leads at mid-market & enterprise. Must include a simple inbound routing play (who to tag for govcloud/privates).

Priya: Idea — 1) problem statement 2) 3 deployment modes w/ one-line tradeoffs 3) SLA bullets 4) security controls (KMS, audit logs, VPC) 5) quick benchmark snapshot. Keep it one page.

Leo: For routing: inbound form -> qualify (region, data sensitivity) -> if "regulated" or "private" tag @Priya + @Leo, else tag growth. Also need an email snippet for AE follow-up.

Kai: I can do a 2-column layout: left: short pitch + quick bullets; right: visual rubric (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with icons. Want micro-CTA chips for "request demo" and "security brief".

Jordan: Benchmark nugget for the one-pager: median p95 latency 75ms on hosted for chat, typical token cost reduction 18% from prefix caching, and can hit 99.95% for Dedicated with SLA. Keep numbers rounded.

Maya: Love it. Can we add a 1-line customer anecdote: "Cut inference costs ~20% while improving tail latency" — anonymized. Also a one-sentence value prop for platform teams.

Priya: Draft inbound routing flow (for side panel in doc):
```
1. Lead fills form -> picks deployment need
2. If "security/compliance" -> route to Solutions (tag: @Priya)
3. If "high-throughput SLA" -> route to AE (tag: @Leo)
4. Else -> Growth (trial nurture)
```

Maya: Nice. Also we need 3 one-line social posts — short + 1 stat + CTA. Kai can mock visual.

Kai: Mocking up now. Suggested social copy (30s read):
- "Tired of trading latency for cost? Our inference runtime gives predictable performance across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Learn how -> [link]"
- "Enterprise controls + developer experience: VPC, KMS, audit logs, and a unified API. Request the security brief. -> [link]"
- "Canary rollouts, SLA-backed Dedicated, and smart routing to keep apps online. RSVP for our webinar -> [link]"

Jordan: Webinar plan: 30–40 mins. 15m product + 10m benchmarks/bench. narrative + 10m Q&A. Target date: Thu next week 10am PT. Need slide deck + short demo.

Leo: I'll line up 2 field-ready follow-up templates: 1) Security buyer, 2) Platform buyer. Short email + 1-pager attached.

Maya: Action items: Kai (design one-pager + social visuals) by EOD tomorrow; Jordan (final benchmarks + slide outline) by EOD today; Priya (routing snippet + audit checklist) by noon; Leo (AE follow-up templates) by EOD tomorrow. I'll stitch and publish to content kit and hand off to growth.

launch-bot: Created card #MK-4823 in Launch backlog (owner: Maya). Reminder set for 48h. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Thanks team — let's keep this lightweight and shipable. Quick check-in tomorrow 10am PT. :sparkles:
